summary: Public Company Management Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 and Waiver to its June 30, 2026 Share Exchange Agreement with Physicians Capital Management Corporation and Conrad Ivie, M.D. The amendment revises voting and conversion terms of Series A Voting, Series B-1 and Series B-2 Convertible Preferred Stock to be issued at closing, and corrects Physicians' capitalization from 10,000 to 10,000,000 authorized and outstanding common shares. It also waives Voting Agreement and Lock-Up Agreement deliverables and related closing conditions. No price, premium or closing date stated. Watch for revised closing mechanics, preferred conversion overhang and remaining conditions to the share exchange.
